spread_description: The flow of a situation across time: past, present and future.

cards.position_meaning: Roots and events already shaping the situation.
cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.meaning: The knight rides slowly, cup extended, a romantic idealist following the call of the heart.

cards.position_meaning: The current dynamics and where you stand now.
cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.meaning: Reversed, grief softens into acceptance and the surviving cups are at last reclaimed.

cards.position_meaning: The likely direction if things continue as they are.
cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.meaning: Ships sail home as the figure watches from a cliff, the first returns of ventures launched with foresight.

synthesis: Reading the Three Card (时间之流三张). Past (过去) draws Knight of Cups (圣杯骑士) upright, highlighting romance, charm, prince charming. Present (现在) draws Five of Cups (圣杯五) reversed, highlighting personal setbacks, self-forgiveness, moving on. Future (未来) draws Three of Wands (权杖三) upright, highlighting preparation, foresight, enterprise. No Major Arcana appeared, so the reading turns on everyday, practical forces you can act on directly rather than on larger destiny-level themes. 1 reversed card(s) point to energies that are blocked, internalised or delayed, and ask to be examined rather than forced.
